analysis_not_source_facts.statement: The opening loss and reversed decider are reasons to avoid treating one upset as a permanent team-strength label. They do not estimate a new true win probability.

Day-4 leaderboard choices must start with the current external paired money line. A near-coin-flip underdog can be an optional differentiation choice under the published screen, but a large long shot does not become sensible merely because 9z once upset Aurora. Rest, roster and form context are disclosed separately; no numerical adjustment is manufactured.

unverified_adjustments.source_of_limitation: No independently observed evidence in the retrieved pages quantifies these values. The fields stay blank and are not probability inputs.
